title: Finite gluing across completion with both prescribed restrictions
statement: Let A be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], U its punctured spectrum [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], q:Y→U finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. Let C be its maximal-ideal completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], c:Spec C→Spec A and W=c⁻¹(U). Given a finite s:E→Spec C and an isomorphism Y×_U W≅s⁻¹(W) over W [def-pc-fibre-product], there exists a finite r:F→Spec A with isomorphisms Y≅r⁻¹(U) over U and F×_Spec(A) Spec C≅E over Spec C.

source.place: Tag 0BLH; More on Algebra, Proposition 15.91.16 and Remark 15.91.20

proof.text: Choose generators f_i of the maximal ideal. Their principal opens cover U. Write q over D(f_i) as Spec B_i and E as Spec B′. The supplied isomorphism identifies the localizations of B′ with B_i tensored with C, compatibly with the overlap maps of q. This is an object of the finite module gluing category for A→C and the f_i. Apply More on Algebra, Proposition 15.91.16 to obtain a finite A-module B. Transfer multiplication and unit using full faithfulness (Remark 15.91.20); faithfulness verifies the algebra identities.

Set F=Spec B. The comparison maps give compatible local isomorphisms over D(f_i), hence an isomorphism Y≅r⁻¹(U) over U. The comparison with B′ gives F×_Spec(A) Spec C≅E over Spec C. The base compatibility gives the two morphism equalities. The zero algebra handles empty covers. This construction uses no depth, flatness, or etaleness assumption.

theorem exists_finite_model_of_completed_model
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens)
    (hU : ∀ x : Spec (.of A), x ∈ U ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ U.toScheme) [IsFinite q]
    (E : Scheme.{u}) (s : E ⟶ Spec
      (.of (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))) [IsFinite s]
    (hext :
      let c := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A)))
      let W := c ⁻¹ᵁ U
      ∃ e : pullback q (c ∣_ U) ≅ (s ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme,
        e.hom ≫ s ∣_ W = pullback.snd q (c ∣_ U)) :
    ∃ (F : Scheme.{u}) (r : F ⟶ Spec (.of A)), IsFinite r ∧
      (∃ e : Y ≅ (r ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme, e.hom ≫ r ∣_ U = q) ∧
      ∃ e : pullback r (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A)))) ≅ E,
        e.hom ≫ s = pullback.snd r (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))))
